name: zentra
description: Zentra monolith workspace: apps/web, apps/api, apps/mobile, shared packages

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: npm --prefix packages/domain run build && npm --prefix packages/contracts run build && npm --prefix packages/api-client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm --prefix packages/domain run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/contracts run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/api-client run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run check:routes && npm run check:arch && npm run metrics:fail
